ticks.note: Tick 1 enters A; its transition is delayed. x = 0, not terminated.
The transition into the final state B runs its effect (x = 1). Every region of the root is now in a final state, so the root terminates: terminated (_TERM) is true in this tick.
After termination nothing reacts any more. _TERM is false again: it marks only the tick in which the root terminated. x keeps its value 1.
